backlog.title: Restore spec-pinned end-to-end behavior (BUG-001 series wiring + BUG-002 path display)
backlog.description: Both major bugs are cross-module wiring/regression defects where every unit test exercises pieces in isolation: BUG-001 (src/pi/index.ts:241-248 projects the enriched RunMember runs payload to bare keys, permanently disabling series-bigram enrichment — typed-word chain arming, series-first successor ordering, run-casing display, /acwords markers) and BUG-002 (path candidates display/insert their edge-trimmed key because store.ts upsert discards the verbatim display for casing-'lower' sightings and resolveCompletionCasing returns the trimmed key — losing leading '/', '../', '~' that spec 04 rule 4d and spec 09 integration item 7 pin). Fixes are confined, validated seams: the store already accepts RunMemberInput, and both UI paths render MatchResult.display faithfully. Each fix lands with mirrored-fixture updates and a new production-composition test layer (PRD recommendation) so the seam itself is exercised.

subtasks.title: provider.ts PIN comment for the no-re-request-after-apply contract
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: bug003-004-widget-provider.md §2. Verified evidence (current node_modules dist): pi-tui editor.js menu-accept Tab site ≈:538-552 (applyCompletion → cancelAutocomplete → return; NO requestAutocomplete) and forced single-item fast path ≈:1895-1906 (applyCompletion → requestRender → return; NO cancelAutocomplete — PRD's 'both call cancelAutocomplete' is imprecise; the load-bearing shared fact is neither re-requests). Existing PIN style template: provider.ts:≈313-331 (getSuggestions force-read PIN citing editor.js line + pi-tui version + 're-verify on upgrade'). Confirm the installed version from node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-tui/package.json before writing so the PIN cites it.
2. INPUT: The verified contract above; the applyCompletion override at src/pi/provider.ts:679-735 (the consumption site where an apply's results are handled — chain re-arm + grant reset — and where a re-request would be observable).
3. LOGIC: Add a PIN comment inside the applyCompletion override (before the delegated return): pi-tui issues NO request after an apply (cite BOTH call sites with line refs and the pi-tui version); therefore the fallback path's post-Tab extension offer (spec 07 'Post-Tab extension offer' fallback paragraph) and the zero-char chain offer surface only on the NEXT keystroke's request — the degradation spec 07 explicitly accepts; re-verify both call sites on any pi-tui upgrade. No behavior change — comment-only plus the matching spec-07 re-verify-list bullet drafted for the drift report. TDD not applicable to a comment; the battery in S2 pins the behavior the comment describes.
4. OUTPUT: The PIN at the consumption site (grep 're-request|re-offer|post-applyCompletion' in src/pi/provider.ts now matches); a drafted fifth re-verify-list bullet ('no re-request after applyCompletion (both apply call sites...)'; update 'Four'→'Five' intro wording) delivered as drift content to P2.M2.T2.S2.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] The PIN comment IS the doc; spec/07 h3.15 mirror is recorded as drift (P2.M2.T2.S2) because pipeline agents must not edit spec/*.md.

subtasks.title: Fallback-path post-accept battery (provider + display layers)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: bug003-004-widget-provider.md §2.4. Harnesses: test/provider-live.test.ts (createHapaxProvider over a vi.fn() mock current; fabricated Sightings; one request = one getSuggestions call), test/chaining-gating.test.ts (:79-115 editingCurrent + suggest(p,lines,line,col,opts) — the closest request-by-request fallback harness), test/provider-display.test.ts (display layer under fake timers; emissions recorded as value sequences; editorApplyCompletion/prefixIsAnchorSafe from test/helpers/editor-sim.ts), adversarial-typing.test.ts Probe C (drives the chain through the provider's REAL applyCompletion with visible buffer splices). There is NO way (and no need) to make pi-tui re-request in these doubles — that is precisely the pinned contract.
2. INPUT: The PIN from P2.M2.T1.S1; provider API: getSuggestions(lines,line,col,opts), applyCompletion(lines,cursorLine,cursorCol,item,prefix), __hapaxLive()/__hapaxKey() introspection; editorApplyCompletion for pi-tui's prefix.length deletion math.
3. LOGIC: New battery (provider-live.test.ts style, chained via editingCurrent): seed a ladder store (implement/implements/implementation); getSuggestions at 'implem' (force:false) → accept the top item via the provider's REAL applyCompletion (arming side effect fires, buffer visibly spliced with editorApplyCompletion math); then assert (a) the provider NEVER self-requests (no getSuggestions activity without an explicit new call — document as the pin), (b) the NEXT explicit getSuggestions at the post-apply cursor (the next keystroke's request, chaining-gating's suggest() shape) returns the post-Tab extension offer set with a prefixIsAnchor-safe prefix, (c) clean state: chain armed at the FINAL accepted word, grant reset exactly once per arm, __hapaxLive()/__hapaxKey() consistent, no Tab-accept rest-of-word suppression armed (spec 07 h3.11: unconditional). Display-layer companion (provider-display.test.ts style, fake timers): after the apply, the display layer emits NOTHING until the next getSuggestions (no pending swap, no timer promotion — emissions sequence recorded empty). Mock: the vi.fn() current provider + fabricated stores only; no editor.
4. OUTPUT: The h3.11 fallback-path battery the PRD found missing (today only the widget-path battery exists, widget.test.ts ≈:2556); a pi-tui upgrade that adds post-apply re-requests now trips a documented, pinned contract.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Battery banner cites spec 07 h3.11 fallback paragraph + the PIN location from P2.M2.T1.S1. No user-facing change.
